item.title: Assam Ministerial Committee Set to Brief CCTOA on Plan for Tribal Status Grant
item.description: Assam forms a ministerial panel to brief CCTOA on the proposal for ST status to six communities, days after clearing the GoM report. Key updates include Swahid Smarak inauguration plans, pay hikes, ex-gratia revision and land patta approvals.

item.title: Guwahati Police Apprehend Two Mobile Thieves in Separate Cases
item.description: Details of both operations were shared by the police via their official ‘X’ handle on Tuesday, December 2.

item.title: Words of Contradiction: Minister Says 'Sanchaar Saathi' Can Be Uninstalled; Govt Directive Says Otherwise
item.description: Digital rights groups and tech experts also flagged inconsistencies between the minister’s remarks and the written directive.

item.title: Assam Engages in Discussions with Tai Community to Introduce Several Initiatives; Check Details
item.description: One of the key initiatives taken is that Dibrugarh University will collaborate with a leading university in Thailand to promote Thai language studies.

item.title: Two Anti-Drug Operations Lead to Major Seizures in Assam’s Sribhumi
item.description: Assam Police conducted two swift anti-drug operations, recovering 139.47g heroin and 376.62kg ganja. Three people were arrested as investigators traced links to wider supply routes.

item.title: Guwahati Police Seize ₹10 Lakh Fake Currency, One Held
item.description: Guwahati police seized ₹10 lakh in fake currency during a checking drive in Boragaon on December 02 2025, detaining one suspect and launching a probe into the counterfeit network.

item.title: Centre Wants Govt App Installed on Every Phone; Netizens Angry, Apple Says ‘No’
item.description: The government’s latest communication to mobile manufacturers stated that the app must be pre-installed, visible and active at the time of first use.

item.title: Guwahati Cyber PS Traces Fraud Transfer, Returns ₹3,00,000 to Complainant
item.description: Guwahati Police trace and recover ₹3,00,000 lost to cyber fraud after a complaint filed on September 2. Cyber PS team blocks the transaction and returns the full amount. Investigation under way.

item.title: Dispute over Money Sparks Firing Inside Shop in Assam’s Kharupetia
item.description: A financial dispute between Munna Saha and trader Ananta Biswas at a Kharupetia jewellery shop escalated into gunfire on Monday night in Assam’s Darrang district. One person was injured. Police recovered a 9mm pistol and detained Biswas for questioning.

item.title: HIV Cases Rise Sharply Among Injecting Drug Users in Assam; Over 33,000 Now Living With the Virus
item.description: Assam’s HIV report shows lower prevalence than national average, rising IDU cases, progress in detection and awareness..
